engine finding during re-verification: when two token types can both match at one position (a generic quoted vs request over the same span, or status vs bytes over a digit run) the resolved-token stream collapses to the first token while Success=true, and whole-file GLR paths compound exponentially. The nginx grammar was redesigned so every position admits exactly one token: status, bytes and the quoted referer+agent tail are absorbed into one digit-anchored stb token (walker splits the fields); the logs batteries and whole-file mode are green again
